name: Fault to Restoration
description: Manages operational faults from initial detection or reporting through containment, diagnosis, restoration, verification and closure.

name: Incident
description: Manages incidents from reporting through assessment, response, recovery, investigation and closure.

name: Cybersecurity Incident
description: Manages cybersecurity incidents through identification, containment, remediation, recovery and closure.

name: Security and Access Control
description: Manages authorization and controlled access to protected physical and digital resources.

name: Cybersecurity Vulnerability
description: Manages identified cybersecurity vulnerabilities through assessment, remediation, verification and closure.

name: Permit to Work
description: Controls authorization of hazardous or otherwise controlled work before execution.

name: Permit to Use
description: Controls authorization to use equipment, facilities or resources subject to qualification or safety requirements.
